"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Thousands of National Guardsmen and reservists have been forced to leave their families and jobs for more than a year with no end in sight because the current administration ignored the need for a true coalition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In a Democratic Administration, the need for a true coalition will be addressed, and National Guardsmen and reservists will not be forced to leave their families and jobs for more than a year.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America must build a coalition of countries, including the other permanent members of the UN Security Council, to share the political, economic, and military responsibilities of Iraq with the United States.",
